_comment: Config for .github/workflows/orchestrator.yml, read by .factory/scripts/run-agent.sh. Human-maintained — agents (per coder.nlspec.md / qa.nlspec.md) are forbidden from editing .factory/**, so this file is a safe place for orchestrator-only tuning.
label: build
_modelComment: Every agent call goes through OpenRouter (see README's 'Model selection' section). 'harness' selects which CLI runs the stage: claude-code, opencode, or codex. 'model' is an OpenRouter slug, e.g. '~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest' or 'openai/gpt-5.3-codex'. 'maxTurns' is honored by claude-code only -- the job's timeout-minutes is the universal cap. These three are top-level defaults; override any of them per stage in 'stages' below. Resolution order per stage/key: workflow_dispatch override > stages.<stage>.<key> > the top-level default here.
